name: Michael Gahler - Considérant N - Am 3
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: N. whereas EU accession is a merit-based process based on full compliance with the Copenhagen criteria, including the stability of democratic institutions, the rule of law, judicial independence, the fight against corruption and respect for fundamental rights; whereas Ukraine, like any other candidate country, must be assessed strictly on the basis of its fulfilment of those criteria and should not benefit from any preferential treatment or accelerated procedures;
